name: Auto Layout
description: Play in the editor and a layout builds itself around you: orbs where you click, portals, blocks and spikes.

live.name: Build while playing
live.description: Objects appear right behind you during the playtest. Turn off to build everything when the playtest stops.

fp-count.name: Frame perfects
fp-count.description: How many of your cube / robot jumps are turned into frame-perfect jumps.

fp-leniency.name: Frame perfect leniency
fp-leniency.description: Extra room around frame-perfect spikes, in units (a block is 30). 0 = a true one-frame window, higher = easier.

difficulty.name: Difficulty (1-5)
difficulty.description: 1 = wide and simple, 5 = tight. Changes wall distance, spike rows, speeds, which orbs appear, straight-fly tunnels and more.

speed-portals.name: Random speed portals
speed-portals.description: A speed portal appears in front of you every few seconds.

orbs.name: Jump orbs
orbs.description: Clicking in mid-air (cube, robot, ball) creates an orb right where you are. Harder difficulties add red, black and dash orbs.

pads.name: Jump pads
pads.description: Pads appear in front of your feet in cube / robot parts.

platforms.name: Platforms (stairs)
platforms.description: Some jumps end on a new platform that appears under you, so the level climbs like stairs.

gravity-portals.name: Gravity portals
gravity-portals.description: Upside-down flying in ship / UFO / wave / swing parts (difficulty 3 and up).

mini-portals.name: Random mini portals
mini-portals.description: A mini / normal size portal appears in front of you now and then.
